headline: Medium prompt-injection and cascading-error risk from Perplexity outputs feeding plano’s OpenAI-compatible gateway; no direct shared channel is documented.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Perplexity can browse and emit web-derived content, while plano exposes an OpenAI-compatible chat endpoint and processes agentic signals. A direct shared channel is not documented, but if Perplexity output is forwarded into plano, prompt injection can ride through default text handling. Uncertainty about the bridge escalates this above low.
conditions: IF Perplexity output is copied or forwarded into plano prompts without sanitization
IF plano treats upstream text as instructions rather than untrusted content
mitigations: Add a fixed instruction/data delimiter in the handoff
Strip HTML, markdown links, and quoted instructions before forwarding
Require a human review step for any web-derived text
Use a prompt-injection detector on Perplexity outputs
requires-engineering: enforce provenance tags end-to-end

B_data_leakage.rationale: Perplexity touches uploaded documents and browsing context, and plano touches logs, traces, and metrics. No shared filesystem, OAuth principal, or direct data bridge is documented, so leakage is not established. The main plausible exposure is accidental copying of sensitive Perplexity content into plano logs or traces, which is limited and configuration-dependent.
conditions: IF sensitive Perplexity document content is pasted into plano inputs
IF plano logs request/response payloads containing that content
mitigations: Disable verbose request logging in plano
Redact document text before forwarding to plano
Use separate workspaces for the two agents
Review retention settings for logs and traces
requires-engineering: add field-level redaction

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Perplexity has no filesystem write, shell, or git mutation, while plano’s listed capabilities are limited to broad network egress and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Because neither profile shows overlapping write access to the same mutable resource, direct capability conflict is unlikely. The remaining risk is only coordination friction through shared inputs, not destructive contention.
conditions: IF both agents are later granted write access to the same directory or repo
IF plano is configured to mutate shared state outside the shown profile
mitigations: Keep both agents read-only with respect to shared assets
Avoid pointing plano at mutable repositories
Use per-agent output directories
Add lockfiles if shared writes are introduced
requires-engineering: implement concurrency locks

D_cascading_error.rationale: Perplexity produces cited answers from browsing, and plano is an AI gateway that can route or act on model outputs. If plano consumes Perplexity text as authoritative without verification, errors or hallucinations can cascade into downstream decisions. The pairwise pathway exists in default text workflows, but no direct action authority is documented, so medium fits.
conditions: IF plano forwards Perplexity answers into downstream prompts or routing decisions
IF no verification or source-checking step is inserted between them
mitigations: Require citation checks before reuse
Add a confidence threshold for forwarded answers
Insert a human approval step for high-impact outputs
Compare Perplexity claims against a second source
requires-engineering: add structured verification gates

E_compliance.rationale: Perplexity’s docs indicate vendor-hosted processing of search queries and uploaded documents, while plano’s profile shows logs, traces, and metrics but no residency or certification claims. With no documented mismatch, compliance risk is limited to accidental placement of regulated data into either system. The other agent is cited because the risk is about cross-system handling, not a single-agent violation.
conditions: IF regulated data is entered into Perplexity uploads or plano logs
IF the deployment requires residency or retention guarantees not shown here
mitigations: Avoid regulated data in both systems
Review retention settings before use
Separate EU and US data flows
Document a DPA before production use
requires-engineering: obtain compliance attestations
